newsitem.title: USA: News' Evans named Tele-Comm president.
newsitem.headline: News' Evans named Tele-Comm president.

text.p: Tele-Communications Intl Inc, a unit of Tele-Communications Inc, said Monday it has appointed David Evans as president and chief operating officer, effective September 1.

It said Evans, who is joining the company from News Corp NCP.AX where he has been executive vice president since July 1996, will perform both functions until sometime in 1998, when he will assume the role of chief executive officer.
Fred Vierra, the current CEO, will remain vice chairman for an indefinite period, it said.
